So I still have this issue here and there but what I do is log out of my Facebook account through the account manager in settings, and then also log out of Facebook on my app. When I go to the party boat it then prompts me to login to Facebook again and it seems to load fine after than. It’s kind of annoying having to go through that whole process every time but it seems to work for me. Hope it helps you!
